name: Taurian World School
area: P. O. Dundigara, via R.K. Mission
description: About Us We at , help our students to develop into independent, conscious and sensitive individuals. With comprehensive curricular and co-curricular activities, we build and empower their character, sculpt their personalities and nurture their skills. Taurian World School VISION Taurian World School, vision is to become the world’s leading scholastic institution by providing holistic education to our students. Our goal is to empower our students to thrive in an environment that demands standards of conduct, ethical behaviour, integrity, spiritual values, community service and competition. Within a supportive and caring environment, we see that our students are encouraged to set goals and strive for excellence, while inculcating leadership skills and a sense of individual responsibility. We want our students to learn to make their own decisions and to collectively handle responsibilities in a structure that works like a student-run corporation. MISSION Taurian World School, strives to create responsible citizens who are confident and prepared to shape their future and that of their local and global community. The school guides its graduates to meet their potential, recognizing and developing their individual talents and characters. Taurian students are passionate learners, empathetic towards others, and ready to take the lead in their chosen field. WHY TAURIAN? We’re voted as the Best International School In Ranchi! 45 acre campus equipped with latest amenities. Teaching processes promotes innovative and experiential learning. Well-equipped medical dispensary and on-call ambulance. Assistance in developing student’s artistic skills and co-curricular activities. Awarded as the Best School to provide global exposure. Certified as a career-focused school by Univariety . 2017 Taurian World School has once again been awarded by EducationWorld for the 7th consecutive time, as Jharkhands No.1 Co-ed Boarding School, 2017. Awarded trophy for “Best school in Jharkhand to provide Global Exposure” by ASSOCHAM – Shri Saryu Rai, the Honourable Minister for Parliamentary Affairs, Food, Public distribution & Consumer Affairs, on 20th May, 2017. Rated among top 5 star school in India by Pioneer Edition for four consecutive years – 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017. Dr. Subhash Kumar was honoured and felicitated with “Guru Samman” Award organised by Prabhat Khabar at RIMS auditorium on September 11, 2017. Bestowed with the ‘International School Award 2015 -2018’ by British Council. Girls’ Basketball team grabbed the overall 3rd position in CBSE Cluster III Basketball Championship 2017-18 organised by Vidya Bharti Chinmaya Vidyalaya TRELCO, Jamshedpur from September 19th – 23rd, 2017. Our swimmers won 4 Gold, 3 Silver and 2 Bronze medals at CBSE Zonal (East & Far East Zones) Interschool Swimming Championship 2017. Our students participated in 4th Jharkhand State Squash Championship 2017 and acquired 1st position in under 11 category, 2nd position in under 17 category and 3rd position in under 21 category. 2016 Dr. Subhash Kumar, Principal and Mr. Vijay Paul, Academic Coordinator, Middle school were felicitated by Prabhat Khabar, for their outstanding contribution in the field of education on 10th September, 2016. The Telegraph Jharkhand Journal 2016 featured Mr. Amith Bajla, Chairman, as one of the great personalities who have contributed to the educational development of Jharkhand. Awarded the prestigious India’s Best Schools – Jury’s Choice Award 2016 at the 4th National Conference on K12 Leadership, 2016-17 in Chancerry Pavillion, Bangalore. Featured in the Make in India Week in Mumbai in February, 2016 as one of the key Education hubs. Credited as a National Geographic Explorer (NGE) member school. Registered on the French Embassy website as a school that teaches French in India. Recognized by Govt. of Jharkhand as one of the key Education hubs and featured in the Make in India Week in Mumbai in February, 2016. Rated among top 5 star school in India by Pioneer in 2014 and January 2016. Honoured by CBSE to host the following CBSE Sports & Games. name: Vikas Vidyalaya
description: About Us Vikas Vidyalaya is one of the finest and oldest Public Schools in India. The school is located in Ranchi, spreading over 172 acres of pollution free serene campus and is in the lap of Mother Nature. Vikas Vidyalaya is renowned for its long-standing legacy of educational excellence and tradition of rigorous academic achievement. Vikas Vidyalaya is a Co-Educational Residential School catering to the students of grades IV – XII of various states of the country. The education equity of Vikas Vidyalaya, Ranchi does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, nationality, origin, religion, sex, disability, age, genetic information, or economic status in its programs and activities. Vikas Vidyalaya is affiliated with Central Board of Secondary Education, New Delhi. It is a member of the ‘Indian Public-School Conference’ and an ISO 9001:2000 certified school. Vikas Vidyalaya, Ranchi is managed by MANAV VIKAS VIDYALAYA TRUST, Kolkata. It was established in 1952 and inaugurated by the first President of Republic of India Dr. Rajendra Prasad in 1953. The school is a rich blend of traditional education yet keeps in tune with the modern trends. The well-defined ETHOS has been kept alive by well qualified team of educators since its inception. Growing even after sixty-seven years of excellence, the school is not just one of the finest and oldest public schools of India, but also a temple of ethical and traditional values.

name: Bishop Westcott Boys' School
description: About Us The Bishop Westcott Schools were founded by the Right Rev. Dr. Foss Westcott, Bishop of Chotanagpur in 1921. Bishop Westcott Boys' School was founded in 1927.Initially, the school was meant for Anglo Indian children, most of whose parents were either missionaries or in the Foreign Service. Later on other children of other communities were taken in and the school achieved a secular status. The school premises are situated on the lands of the villages of jorar and Namkum, which are in the outskirts of Ranchi. Namkum is a sleepy hollow approx. 6km east of Ranchi, on the banks of the famous Subarnarekha river. It has its own Railway station and is easily accessible by Road. As there are no major industries nearby, it is free from pollution and is also a very quiet place, the ideal setting for a school.

description: About Us Madhusthali Vidyapeeth, established in 1997 it’s located in Madhupur, Deoghar, Jharkhand, is a renowned co-ed residential school affiliated with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examination, New Delhi. Offering classes from 1 to 12, with a minimum entry age of 4 years for KG, it admits 50 students at the entry level grade, with a total strength of 1,500 students. Madhusthali Vidyapeeth was founded by Madhusthali Vidyapeeth Trust administered by the trustees of the reputed and renowned MCKV Group running educational institutions like M. C. Kejriwal Vidyapeeth and MCKV Institute of Engineering, Kolkata. With an average of 50 students per class and 50 dedicated teachers, the school operates from Monday to Saturday, from 8 AM to 2 PM. It boasts medical facilities on campus, ensuring the well-being of its students with qualified professionals.

name: Delhi Public School
description: About Us The ultimate aim of the school is to contribute to the all-round development of the child where a child is able to become a role model in society. We believe that education is not only about books or syllabi but also about learning, practical applications, ethics, life skills, traditions, culture, inter personal skills and self-realization. Delhi Public School, Chas, a Day Cum Residential School, affiliated to CBSE (Affiliation No.-3430369) is part of the extended Delhi Public School Society which is renowned worldwide for its yeoman service in the field of education. It aims to provide an environment of learning which will help to shape the India of tomorrow. We aim to provide an integrated learning structure which helps develop the child holistically in academics, extra-curricular activities and in various life skills. We aim to provide an environment where the child can self-realize one’s own potential and is able to gain the skills to maximize the power of his or her capabilities. To achieve this, we bring together the best technology and systems, logistics and infrastructure, highly qualified and competent faculty, excellent learning material, dedicated support staff and a host of opportunities for the child to showcase and develop his/her skills. And most important of all, we all share the same vision as you – of your child being a role model for others. School Philosophy Our philosophy of education has always been meeting the needs of each and every individual child. We endeavour to instil a value system in each individual so as to help him/her withstand the test of time. We take upon ourselves the task of not only raising career conscious students but also socially responsible global citizens. We aim to impart holistic education to ensure that our children grow up as individuals who are morally upright, emotionally balanced, culturally integrated, socially aware and spiritually oriented. Our main objectives are : To promote all round development of the child; To stimulate lifetime love for learning; To develop physical, social, mental and spiritual fitness; To Inculcate a competitive spirit and desire to excel.

name: Don Bosco Academy
description: About Us McCluskiegunj was founded on 16th May 1933 by Mr E.T.McCluskie one of the founder members of the Colonization Society of India. This Society had acquired 10,000 acres of virgin land from the Ratu Maharaja on a perpetual lease to essentially establish a "Mooluck" or Homeland for the Anglo Indian community. It comprised of several villages - prominent among them are :-Lapra, Konka, Hesalong&Mayapur. McCluskiegunj is located on the Chotanagpur plateau at an elevation of 1500 - 2000 ft. above sea level, and is about 60 kms. from Ranchi town, and therefore enjoys a comfortable and moderate climate. This tribal hamlet is well connected by rail and road as well. McCluskiegunj is located on the Barkakhana loop line of the Indian Railways. This school is located in the beautiful and scenic Chotanagpur hills. The excellent temperate climate in summer and chilled winter, fresh surroundings, plenty of vegetation, fresh air and the notable absence of any pollution makes it an ideal location for an educational institution. McCluskiegunj has been declared as an official Tourist Centre of the Jharkhand State Government. Being a mere 60 km away from the State Capital Ranchi, and is therefore well connected by road, rail and air and also has a good network of mobile and landline telephones, broadband and internet connectivity. Today McCluskiegunj can be considered more of an urban township, in a rural setting, progressive and emerging.
